label: The post-tag window is 38 commits, 2111 files, 576916 insertions and 81318 deletions, but 399743 of those insertions are two scratch patch dumps: pre-phase4.patch at 202831 lines and pre-phase3.patch at 196912. A post-tag diffstat measures research scaffolding, not shipped change.

The post-tag change set is dominated by spec packets: specs/hooks-plugins-extensions is 1075 files and 480845 insertions, specs/cli-external-orchestration 429 files. Only three framework surfaces moved: .skilled/hooks at 378 files, .skilled/skills at 118 files and .skilled/commands at 6 files.

README.md changed exactly three lines after the v4.0.2.1 tag and all three are hook-library cleanup propagation: Pi and OpenCode added to the history-lookup sender list, the session-handover README link split into state-files, runtime-behavior and troubleshooting, and the hook-core name list rewritten.

The README hook-core list matches the tree exactly at 27 names for 27 directories, including cli-dispatch, completion-evidence, ask-surface-guard, subagent-dispatch-guard and codex-global-hooks-check. This section is current and a rewrite must not treat it as stale.
The hook cleanup deleted .skilled/scripts/git-hooks/tests/pre-commit.test.sh outright (83 lines removed), while source-root-selection.test.sh and two READMEs were rewritten in place.

There are 15 top-level skills and every one has a SKILL.md, but only 14 have a ROUTER.md. local-webflow is the sole exception: an OpenCode-authored surface skill with README, references, assets, benchmark, manual-testing-playbook and graph-metadata, no ROUTER.md and no mode-registry.json.

Seven skills are hubs with a mode-registry.json and together they route 42 modes: sk-doc 15, cli-external-orchestration 8, mcp-tooling 8, sk-code 5, sk-design 3, system-deep-loop 2, cli-classifier 1. The registry keys modes by numeric index, not by a workflowModes field.

The command surface is 44 markdown files under .skilled/commands at depth 3, which matches the 44 tracked commands the v4.0.2.1 advisor policy covers. The agreement is corroboration of a 1:1 layout, not proof of it.

The agent surface is 11 markdown files under .skilled/agents at depth 1, which is the repo's own canonical runtime path, so an agent table must be built from .skilled/agents rather than .claude/agents.

Exactly eight runtime folders exist at the repository root, .claude .codex .cursor .devin .dsh .opencode .pi .vibe, beside the shared .skilled, and .hermes is absent. This confirms the v4.0.2.0 Hermes removal against the tree and validates the eight-runtime support matrix.
README.md is still 1773 lines and its size did not move with the three-line post-tag edit, so the rewrite problem is structural rather than a file left behind by a large change.
A diffstat over a range that includes research packet scratch artifacts must not be quoted as a measure of shipped change.
A README claim about a file or directory list is only stale if the tree contradicts it; the hook-core list was assumed stale and proved correct.
The strategy Next Focus section still named Q1 residual while the same file's key-questions list already carried Q1 as answered, so the dispatch focus duplicated completed work.
